program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":   (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "I_tail":    (8e-6, 4e-6, 14e-6),    # EA tail current
    "I_top":     (6e-6, 3e-6, 10e-6),    # PMOS mirror (output branch) current
    "L_ea":      (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # L of mirrors / current sources
    "Cc":        (20e-12, 3e-12, 150e-12),  # Ahuja compensation cap vout -> fold node
    "L_pass":    (0.25, 0.15, 0.5),
    "gmid_pass": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX
    "I_div":     (12e-6, 4e-6, 16e-6),   # feedback divider current (also min pass bleed)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = 1.8
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3)
    imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)

    It, Itop, Lea = p["I_tail"], p["I_top"], p["L_ea"]
    Is = Itop + It / 2.0          # NMOS fold sink current
    Ipb = It / 2.0                # PMOS bias diode current
    gmid_n, gmid_p = 11.0, 10.0
    vx = 0.25                     # target fold-node voltage

    # ---- NMOS bias: IREF -> Rb -> diode; cascode gate = ibias node
    mn0 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, Lea, iref, vds=0.6)
    mn_s = lut.size("n", gmid_n, Lea, Is, vds=vx)            # fold sinks
    mn_pb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, Lea, Ipb, vds=0.9)         # sinks PMOS-bias diode current
    mc = lut.size("n", 14.0, 0.5, Itop, vds=0.4, vsb=vx)     # NMOS cascodes
    vcas = vx + mc.vgs
    Rb = max((vcas - mn0.vgs) / iref, 1e3)

    # ---- PMOS tail bias
    mp0 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, Lea, Ipb, vds=1.0)
    mp_t = lut.size("p", gmid_p, Lea, It, vds=0.25)

    # ---- diff pair (bulk tied to common source -> vsb=0)
    min_ = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], 0.5, It / 2.0, vds=0.9)
    vs_tail = vref + min_.vgs

    # ---- PMOS mirror load (gate referenced to vin)
    mtop = lut.size("p", gmid_p, Lea, Itop, vds=0.8)

    # ---- pass device
    mpass = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], p["L_pass"], imax, vds=vin - vout)
    mfing = int(min(200, max(1, round(mpass.W / 50.0))))

    # ---- divider
    Rtot = vout / p["I_div"]
    R2 = Rtot * vref / vout
    R1 = Rtot - R2
    beta = R2 / (R1 + R2)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.R("Rb", "ibias", "nb", Rb)
    n.dev("MN0", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mn0)
    n.dev("MN1", "x1", "nb", "vss", "vss", mn_s)
    n.dev("MN2", "x2", "nb", "vss", "vss", mn_s)
    n.dev("MN3", "pb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mn_pb)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp0)
    n.dev("MP1", "ns", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp_t)
    n.dev("MP2", "x1", "vfb", "ns", "ns", min_)     # feedback side (diode side)
    n.dev("MP3", "x2", "vref", "ns", "ns", min_)    # reference side (output side)
    n.dev("MC1", "n1", "ibias", "x1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("MC2", "gate", "ibias", "x2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("MP4", "n1", "n1", "vin", "vin", mtop)
    n.dev("MP5", "gate", "n1", "vin", "vin", mtop)
    n.dev("MPP", "vout", "gate", "vin", "vin", mpass, m=mfing)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "vfb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "vfb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("Cc", "vout", "x2", p["Cc"])

    # ---- first-order predictions
    gm1 = min_.gm
    Ro = 1.0 / (mtop.gds + 1e-12 + mc.gds * (mn_s.gds + min_.gds) / max(mc.gm, 1e-9))
    A_ea = gm1 * Ro
    gmp_h = mpass.gm
    gdsp_h = mpass.gds
    T_dc_h = beta * A_ea * gmp_h / (gdsp_h + 1.0 / Rtot)
    load_reg = 1.0 / (beta * A_ea * gmp_h)
    w_ugf = beta * gm1 / p["Cc"]
    T1k = min(T_dc_h, w_ugf / (2 * PI * 1e3))
    psrr = db(1.0 + T1k)
    line_reg = 1.0 / max(T_dc_h, 1.0)
    cg = mpass.cgg
    gmid_l = min(16.0, p["gmid_pass"] * 1.6)
    dvsg = math.log(imax / (imin + p["I_div"])) / gmid_l * 1.2
    under = dvsg * cg / p["Cc"] + 0.5 * imax * 100e-9 / cl * 0.3
    iq = iref + Ipb + It + 2 * Itop + p["I_div"]
    vos = 2e-3
    return n, {"vout_err_pct": 100 * (vos / beta) / vout, "load_reg": load_reg,
               "line_reg": line_reg, "psrr_1k": psrr, "iq": iq,
               "undershoot": under, "ripple_settled": 3e-3,
               "tail_vsd": vin - vs_tail, "pass_W": mpass.W, "Rb": Rb,
               "ugf_hz": w_ugf / (2 * PI)}
